title: Descent of ordinary open-extension transitions
statement: Let C have object universe c and morphism universe v, let k=max(c,v,r), suppose C is essentially small in k, let J be a Grothendieck topology on C, let U be an object, and let B_n be a tower of commutative ring sheaves with adjacent maps τ_n:B_(n+1)→B_n. Use the actual systems, coefficient maps, evaluations and scalar restrictions of [def-coef-semilinear-system-models]. For any ordinary open datum O [def-pur-sequence-site-open-data] satisfying its actual ordinary Transitions equation, O satisfies DerivedTransitions [def-pur-sequence-open-derived-data]. This is the equation on every object of the ordinary unbounded derived system category with the termwise localized level and coefficient comparisons and the localized composite coefficient-restriction factor.

source.place: Tags 015F (lemma-right-derived-exact-functor) and 05RU (definition-unbounded-derived-category), localization at quasi-isomorphisms; original proof step 7.

proof.text: Apply the ordinary equation degreewise to complexes. Retain the standard exact-derived composition factors in the level and coefficient square isomorphisms. Their factorization formulas follow from [lem-weil-pbc-exact-functor-derived-factorization].

Form the two natural transformations on the derived category and apply localization extensionality [lem-weil-pbc-localization-universal-property]. After postcomposition with the invertible evaluation, extension and restriction factors, naturality reduces both sides to Q of the original chain identity. The extra coefficientRestriction isomorphism descends by its own natural-isomorphism factorization. Cancel factors and take components.

proof_origin.place: Tags 015F (lemma-right-derived-exact-functor) and 05RU (definition-unbounded-derived-category), localization at quasi-isomorphisms; original proof step 7.
